ModMetaData.name: Occupation & Annexation
ModMetaData.author: tmine
ModMetaData.description:
Enemy settlements no longer have to be wiped out. Break their main defense and the survivors capitulate: they drop their weapons and lie down. Occupy the settlement, raise its loyalty and annex it as an autonomous protectorate that produces goods. Collect the stockpile by caravan or request a delivery, and visit your towns to see the locals at work.
Optional integration with Combat Extended (suppression affects morale) and CAI 5000 (surrendered pawns are left alone).
